disambiguation_needed.note: The user reported 'broken' without specifying the symptom. Three distinct failure modes exist; each points to a different cause. Helm or the reporting user should clarify which applies before any code change is made.

mode_a.symptom: Listen button not visible on the page
mode_a.likely_cause: Client-side CSS conflict not visible in static analysis (e.g. browser extension, conflicting user stylesheet, rendering engine issue) OR the user is on a device where position:fixed bottom-left is obscured by browser chrome
mode_a.action: Open browser dev tools · inspect for .echo-btn element · check computed styles · verify it is not display:none or opacity:0

mode_b.symptom: Button visible, click opens panel, Play button does nothing
mode_b.likely_cause: JavaScript runtime error in echo.js or conflict from another script on the page · most likely the site-nav inline script if it throws at runtime
mode_b.action: Open browser console · look for errors before the click · check window.Echo object exists (should be defined if echo.js ran successfully)

mode_c.symptom: Button and panel work, Play is pressed, no audio heard
mode_c.likely_cause: Browser TTS engine not available (some headless or restricted environments) or OpenAI key not set and browser TTS silently failing on a long document
mode_c.action: Check Echo status bar in the panel (it shows 'Ready · browser voice' or an error) · try with a shorter page first · check if window.speechSynthesis.getVoices() returns voices in that browser
